findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 9d6479cc7fab5d1a27d6d3226a285be3f1bf51bb, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The base implementation compared userTenant with documentTenant, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized and the PR-introduced isolation regression is unresolved.
